title: Fuel Economy and Fuel Lid Mentions
summary: Reviews in this topic are mostly about strong fuel economy, while a smaller set mention fuel-system or fuel-lid service issues and several fragments are too ambiguous to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's fuel economy as good, excellent, or impressive, sometimes alongside ride comfort, quietness, or performance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention dissatisfaction with fuel economy or note fuel pot and fuel lid door cover replacement without enough detail to specify the underlying issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments reference fuel economy in vague, comparative, or preference-based ways that do not clearly indicate satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: This topic mixes two related but distinct subjects: fuel economy opinions and fuel lid or fuel system service mentions.
Several sampled fragments are short or context-poor, so the specific complaint or evaluation cannot always be determined.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of overall owner experience.
